sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
She pretended that she was a researcher from the [[Huntik Foundation]] working in the [[Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot]]. When [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Dante Vale]] entered the mausoleum and opened the wall, she revealed that she and her crew were members of [[the Organization]]. She invoked her Titans, [[Impet]] and [[Mindrone]], and tried to attack. However, she and her team were overpowered by Dante and Lok. Her image was later used by the test of the Mausoleum to represent a helpless enemy, trying to tempt Lok and Dante with revenge, but they made it clear were not interested in hurting her, so the image disappeared. {{source|Memory Lane}}

full_text:
Unnamed Suit 043 is a Suit from the Organization. She operated from the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot in Paris, France.

== History ==
She pretended that she was a researcher from the Huntik Foundation working in the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot. When Lok Lambert and Dante Vale entered the mausoleum and opened the wall, she revealed that she and her crew were members of the Organization. She invoked her Titans, Impet and Mindrone, and tried to attack. However, she and her team were overpowered by Dante and Lok. Her image was later used by the test of the Mausoleum to represent a helpless enemy, trying to tempt Lok and Dante with revenge, but they made it clear were not interested in hurting her, so the image disappeared. [Memory Lane]

== Abilities ==

=== Spells Utilized ===
* Augerfrost

=== Titans Bonded ===
* Impet
* Mindrone
